title: OneNote for Android: Copilot chat pane with page summaries and questions
summary: The briefing matches Microsoft's notice and roadmap, including the late-November rollout window and Premium licence requirement. Microsoft's documentation supports the Android connected-experiences control, its administration path and the stated data-handling behaviour.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a new Copilot chat pane in OneNote Mobile on Android.
claims.quote: Microsoft is introducing a new Copilot chat pane in OneNote Mobile (Android) for users licensed with Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium).

claims.claim: The feature generates concise summaries of longer OneNote pages.
claims.quote: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages

claims.claim: Users can ask questions about their notes directly within the OneNote mobile app.
claims.quote: as well as ask questions about their notes, directly within the OneNote mobile app.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has no dedicated page for this Android Summary and Q&A pane yet.
claims.quote: Searched: "OneNote" "Android" "Summary" "Copilot" chat pane; read returned Copilot release-note excerpts and the cited Copilot overview. Results cover other platforms or other OneNote features, not this pane.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The change alters processing of existing customer data by processing accessible OneNote content for summaries and answers.
claims.quote: Copilot chat processes OneNote content that users already have access to in order to generate summaries and answer questions, in accordance with existing Microsoft 365 Copilot data handling, permissions, and security controls.

claims.claim: The update introduces generative AI that analyses note content the user has permission to access.
claims.quote: This update introduces Copilot chat capabilities within OneNote Mobile, allowing generative AI to analyze note content that the user has permission to access.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Copilot only surfaces organisational data to which the user has at least view permissions.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot only surfaces organizational data to which individual users have at least view permissions.

claims.claim: Interactions with Copilot in apps including OneNote store the user's prompt in Copilot activity history.
claims.quote: The stored data includes the user's prompt and Copilot's response, including citations to any information used to ground Copilot's response.

claims.claim: The stored Copilot activity history includes Copilot's response.
claims.quote: We refer to the user's prompt and Copilot's response to that prompt as the "content of interactions" and the record of those interactions is the user's Copilot activity history.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Turning off connected experiences that analyse content makes Copilot features unavailable in OneNote on Android.
claims.quote:
If you turn off connected experiences that analyze your content on devices in your organization, Microsoft Copilot features won't be available to your users in the following apps:

- Excel
- OneNote
- Outlook
- PowerPoint
- Word

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: The connected-experiences control is broader than this pane and also affects Copilot on other platforms.
claims.quote: This applies to when you're running the most current version of these apps on Windows, Mac, iOS, or Android devices.

claims.claim: No other documented feature-disabling setting for OneNote on Android was identified beyond the connected-experiences lever.
claims.quote: Searched: "OneNote" "Android" "Copilot" disable control policy chat; read Copilot privacy and Android privacy controls. Returned settings for harmful-content filtering and the separate Microsoft Copilot mobile app do not document another switch disabling this OneNote pane.

claims.claim: The roadmap and notice describe summaries and question answering, not editing notes or taking actions.
claims.quote: The Copilot chat pane allows users to generate concise summaries of longer OneNote pages and ask questions about their notes

claims.claim: Microsoft says generative AI responses are not guaranteed to be factual.
claims.quote: The responses that generative AI produces aren't guaranteed to be 100% factual.

claims.claim: The notice also suggests informing users about the pane and Summary feature.
claims.quote: Consider informing helpdesk staff and users about the availability of Copilot chat and the Summary feature in OneNote mobile.

claims.claim: The notice names no separate meter for the pane.
claims.quote: Searched: OneNote Android Copilot Summary feature price fair use limits; read supplied MC1309746 in full and the Copilot overview. The notice names the Premium licence but no separate meter.

claims.claim: The notice states no separate charge or feature-specific price for the pane.
claims.quote: Searched: OneNote Android Copilot Summary feature price fair use limits; read supplied MC1309746 in full. Its preparation requirements name a Premium licence, with no separate charge or pane-specific price.

claims.claim: The Copilot overview's usage-based billing section lists Cowork, Code and Autopilot rather than OneNote.
claims.quote:
Microsoft Copilot Cowork
Microsoft Copilot Code (Frontier)
Autopilot (Frontier)

claims.claim: A price specific to this Android pane is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: OneNote Android Copilot chat pane Summary licensing price fair use limit connected experiences disable; OneNote Android Copilot Summary feature price fair use limits. Read MC1309746 and Copilot overview; neither states a pane-specific price.

claims.claim: A fair-use limit specific to this Android pane is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: OneNote Android Copilot Summary feature price fair use limits. Read Copilot overview and linked Limits for features in Microsoft Copilot Chat; the latter applies to users without an add-on and supplies no pane-specific limit.

claims.claim: In Microsoft 365 Apps admin center, the route is Customization > Policy Management > Policy configurations > Create > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings.
claims.quote:
Under Customization, select Policy Management.
On the Policy configurations page, select Create.
On the Start with the basics page
On the Choose the scope page
On the Configure Settings page, select the policies that you want to include

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API that sets this Cloud Policy setting at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Cloud Policy" "API" "Office"; "Cloud Policy" "Microsoft Graph" "settings" API beta; "Cloud Policy" "PowerShell" configure Office privacy. Read Cloud Policy overview and the returned Management Activity API audit-schema excerpt; no operation to set this policy.

claims.claim: The Android setting is named Allow the use of connected experiences in Office that analyze content.
claims.quote: Allow the use of connected experiences in Office that analyze content

claims.claim: The policy is user-scoped, with its target users determined on Choose the scope.
claims.quote: On the Choose the scope page, determine whether the policy configuration applies to all users, specific groups, or to users who anonymously access documents using Office for the web.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy is required to apply the documented privacy settings to Office on Android.
claims.quote: To apply any of these four policy settings for Office on Android devices, you need to use Cloud Policy.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends the Office Apps Administrator role for Cloud Policy administration.
claims.quote: Office Apps Administrator (Recommended) | This role can manage Office apps cloud services, including policy and settings management

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Risk assessment: Change & support; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The default state is on: the pane reaches the licensed Android users it is aimed at without admin action.
claims.quote:
